plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce income exposure.
Reduce SPY to 15% to lower broad market exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, and SOXL to exit downtrending and leveraged positions.
Trim CRWD to 5% to lock in profits and reduce single-name concentration.
This plan aims for capital preservation by cutting all leveraged ETFs and reducing overall risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, but may limit upside potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to comply with concentration limits.
Reduce SPY to 20% to balance broad market exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, and METU to exit underperforming and downtrending assets.
Trim CRWD to 5% to secure profits and manage concentration.
Reduce SOXL to 3% to maintain a small, managed leveraged exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth by reducing overall leverage and concentration.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while maintaining some exposure to quality tech, offering a moderate risk/reward profile.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Reduce SPY to 15% to free up capital for higher growth.
Sell QQQ and SMH to exit underperforming broad and sector indices.
Add to CRWD to 10% to press a strong performing AI/Software name.
Increase METU to 6% and SOXL to 6% to lean into leveraged tech/semiconductor exposure.
This plan aggressively targets growth by increasing exposure to leveraged ETFs and strong performers.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrated positions, leading to higher potential upside but also much larger drawdowns and daily decay risk. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Add to QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.
Reduce SPY to 10% to shift focus from growth to income.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, and SOXL to eliminate growth-oriented and leveraged positions.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce high-beta single-name exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions by rotating into income ETFs and cutting leverage.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income by concentrating in income ETFs and eliminating leveraged/high-beta names. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns.
